decision_rule: Question: do REAL 128x128 blocks of the pinned target turboderp/Qwen3.8-27B-exl3 branch 4.00bpw (revision 113cf7ab958054860e43fb7f3063b1af19171095, model.safetensors shards bound by MODELS.sha256) decode identically in (a) the project's independent bit-at-a-time portable golden, (b) the EXL3-2 CPU codec reference (experiments/exl3_cpu reconstruct()/dense()) and (c) the gfx90a HIP harness' independent C++ host reference (test_runtime --host-fixture, built by build.py from the sources whose hashes equal the 2026-11-01 compile-only receipt; NO GPU kernel executes on this lane)? PASS iff for every sampled block: tensor binding check PASS (fail-closed layout/sidecar check, EXL3 K, MUL1 scalar), CPU reconstruct fp16 sha256 == golden transformed sha256 (bit-exact), CPU dense() relative L2 vs golden operator output <= 0.003 (the EXL3-2 fixture envelope), all values finite, HIP host-fixture status pass and gpu_executed=false. Expected effect: EXL3-2 already proved this codec on 3 real K3/K4 fixtures with 719,096 checks, so exact agreement is expected; the novelty is the pinned Qwen3.8 target, K6 (lm_head, never covered by real fixtures) and edge blocks. Sample size: 28 seeded blocks (seed 20261107; 10 module types x 2 layers x {random, last-block} = up to 20 K4 blocks + 4 K6 lm_head blocks); one disagreement is already the answer, so no further replication is needed. Checkpoints: (1) binding check, (2) CPU codec build, (3) each block (record per block), (4) HIP harness build, (5) HIP host fixture per block. Stop-on-answer: first mismatch/refusal ends the run with verdict FAIL (a finding, rc0); all blocks pass = PASS, done. Stop-on-futility: binding refusal, CPU or HIP build failure = verdict UNKNOWN, nothing sampled. Diagnostic gate, CANDIDATE class, futility-only semantics for any formal gate; not fidelity to the upstream exllamav3 torch decode (no torch donor here) and not device execution: the HIP device run (claimed_run.py, owner-run or leased MI210) is the NEXT row and opens only on PASS.
notes: DF2-EXL3 codec gate on real target blocks. job.py cuts 128x128 native blocks (trellis tiles 8x8, suh/svh slices) out of the 4.00bpw safetensors, builds epyc.exl3.artifact.v1 manifests with source kind real_weight at the pinned revision, computes the portable golden, runs the EXL3-2 CPU codec on the same bytes (cpu_block.cpp), then builds the HIP harness with build.py (compile only) and runs --host-fixture. The smoke runs the binding check, the CPU codec build and two blocks only. Sources pinned in SOURCE.sha256.
